name: @activepieces/piece-twilio
description: Cloud communications platform for building SMS, Voice & Messaging applications

auth.description: The authentication to use to connect to Twilio

username.description: The account SID to use to connect to Twilio

password.description: The auth token to use to connect to Twilio

from.description: The phone number to send the message from

body.description: The body of the message to send

to.description: The phone number to send the message to

aiMetadata.description: Sends an SMS text message from a Twilio phone number to a recipient. Use to notify or message a person by text. Requires the destination number, message body, and a Twilio-owned sender number; sending costs money and delivers a separate message on every call, so it is not idempotent.

phone_number_lookup.name: phone_number_lookup
phone_number_lookup.description: Lookup information about a phone number.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up carrier and line-type intelligence for a single phone number via the Twilio Lookup API. Use to validate or enrich a number (e.g. detect mobile vs landline, carrier) before messaging or calling it. Read-only and idempotent.

make_call.name: make_call
make_call.description: Call a number and say a message.

from.description: The phone number to send the message from

to.description: The phone number to call. Must be in E.164 format (e.g., +15558675310).

message.description: The text message to be converted to speech and spoken to the recipient.

voice.description: The voice to use for the text-to-speech message.

language.description: The language to use for the text-to-speech message.

sendDigits.description: A string of keys to dial after the call is connected. Use 'w' for a half-second pause.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to let the phone ring before assuming no answer. Default is 60.

aiMetadata.description: Places an outbound voice call from a Twilio number that reads a text-to-speech message to the recipient. Use to deliver a spoken notification or alert by phone. Requires both numbers in E.164 format and the message text; each call places a real, billable phone call, so it is not idempotent.

get_message.name: get_message
get_message.description: Retrieves the details of a specific message.

message_sid.description: The unique identifier (SID) of the message to retrieve. It starts with "SM" or "MM".

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full details and status of a single Twilio message by its SID. Use to check delivery status or inspect a known message; requires the message SID (starting with "SM" or "MM"). Read-only and idempotent.

download_recording_media.name: download_recording_media
download_recording_media.description: Download the media file for a specific recording.

recording_sid.description: The unique identifier (SID) of the recording to download. It starts with "RE".

format.description: The desired audio format for the download file.

channels.description: Specify whether to download a mono or dual-channel file. Note: Dual-channel may not be available for all recordings.

aiMetadata.description: Downloads the audio file for a specific Twilio call recording by its SID, returning it as a file (MP3 or WAV). Use to retrieve recorded call audio for storage or further processing; requires the recording SID (starting with "RE"). Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: The authentication to use to connect to Twilio

username.description: The account SID to use to connect to Twilio

password.description: The auth token to use to connect to Twilio

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: The authentication to use to connect to Twilio

username.description: The account SID to use to connect to Twilio

password.description: The auth token to use to connect to Twilio

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_incoming_sms.name: new_incoming_sms
new_incoming_sms.description: Triggers when a new SMS message is received

phone_number.description: The phone number to send the message from

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an inbound SMS message is received on the specified Twilio phone number. Each event represents one incoming text message with its sender, body, and metadata.

new_phone_number.name: new_phone_number
new_phone_number.description: Triggers when you add a new phone number to your account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new phone number is provisioned on the Twilio account. Each event represents one newly added incoming phone number with its capabilities and configuration.

new_recording.name: new_recording
new_recording.description: Triggers when a new call recording is completed and available.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new call recording becomes available on the Twilio account. Each event represents one completed recording, including its call SID, duration, and status.

new_transcription.name: new_transcription
new_transcription.description: Triggers when a new call recording transcription is completed.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a call recording transcription reaches completed status on the Twilio account. Each event represents one finished transcription tied to a recording, including its transcribed text.

new_call.name: new_call
new_call.description: Triggers when a call completes (incoming or outgoing).

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a voice call reaches completed status on the Twilio account, for both inbound and outbound calls. Each event represents one finished call with its direction, participants, duration, and status.

pt.The unique identifier (SID) of the recor: O identificador único (SID) da gravação para download. Ele começa com "RE".
pt.The desired audio format for the downloa: Formato de áudio desejado para o arquivo de download.
pt.Specify whether to download a mono or du: Especifique se deseja baixar um arquivo de canal duplo ou mono. Nota: canal duplo pode não estar disponível para todas as gravações.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
Habilitar para arquivos como PDFs, imagens, etc.

pt.Triggers when you add a new phone number: Aciona quando você adiciona um novo número de telefone à sua conta.
